191	/**
192	 * Converts local command output (e.g. /voice, /cost) to a well-formed
193	 * SDKAssistantMessage so downstream consumers (mobile apps, session-ingress
194	 * v1alpha→v1beta converter) can parse it without schema changes.
195	 *
196	 * Emitted as assistant instead of the dedicated SDKLocalCommandOutputMessage
197	 * because the system/local_command_output subtype is unknown to:
198	 *   - mobile-apps Android SdkMessageTypes.kt (no local_command_output handler)
199	 *   - api-go session-ingress convertSystemEvent (only init/compact_boundary)
200	 * See: https://anthropic.sentry.io/issues/7266299248/ (Android)
201	 *
202	 * Strips ANSI (e.g. chalk.dim() in /cost) then unwraps the XML wrapper tags.
203	 */
204	export function localCommandOutputToSDKAssistantMessage(
205	  rawContent: string,
206	  uuid: UUID,
207	): SDKAssistantMessage {
208	  const cleanContent = stripAnsi(rawContent)
209	    .replace(/<local-command-stdout>([\s\S]*?)<\/local-command-stdout>/, '$1')
210	    .replace(/<local-command-stderr>([\s\S]*?)<\/local-command-stderr>/, '$1')
211	    .trim()
212	  // createAssistantMessage builds a complete APIAssistantMessage with id, type,
213	  // model: SYNTHETIC_MODEL, role, stop_reason, usage — all fields required by
214	  // downstream deserializers like Android's SdkAssistantMessage.
215	  const synthetic = createAssistantMessage({ content: cleanContent })
216	  return {
217	    type: 'assistant',
218	    content: synthetic.message?.content,
219	    message: synthetic.message,
220	    parent_tool_use_id: null,
221	    session_id: getSessionId(),
222	    uuid,
223	  }
224	}
